title: The Rivers School
subtitle: Quebec City, QC · April 16–19, 2027
bodyHtml:
Families are currently viewing The Rivers School sample itinerary. This version provides a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As departure nears, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates.

Day 1: Travel to Quebec City & Upper Town Walking Tour

  • Depart for Quebec City — students bring breakfast to eat en route
  • Rest stops en route as needed — estimated 8–9 hour journey including the border crossing
  • Welcome to Quebec City! Meet your Landmark Leader
  • Landmark Leader–led walking tour of Upper Town
  • Sit-down dinner
  • Guided Ghost Tour of Quebec
  • Hotel accommodations with overnight security (three nights)

Day 2: La Citadelle de Québec & Montmorency Falls

  • Sit-down breakfast
  • Guided tour of La Citadelle de Québec
  • Copper workshop at Cuivres d’Art Albert Gilles
  • Lunch stop
  • Guided tour of Basilique Sainte-Anne-de-Beaupré
  • Visit Montmorency Falls
  • Sit-down dinner
  • Return to hotel accommodations

Day 3: Musée de la Civilisation & Québécois Cooking Lesson

  • Sit-down breakfast
  • Visit the Musée de la Civilisation du Québec
  • Lunch and shopping at Galeries de la Capitale
  • Guided tour and handicraft
  • Cooking lessons & dinner
  • Return to hotel accommodations

Day 4: The Plains of Abraham & the Morrin Centre

  • Sit-down breakfast
  • Soldier of Martello Tower at the Plains of Abraham
  • Visit the Morrin Centre — Discovery Tour
  • Ride the Funiculaire du Vieux-Québec
  • Lunch stop
  • Depart for home
introHeading: The Rivers School, get ready for an unforgettable Quebec City adventure in 2027! ⚜️
introText: From the cobblestone streets of Old Quebec to the thundering drop of Montmorency Falls, this trip brings four centuries of French-Canadian history and culture to life at every turn. Students will step inside the walls of La Citadelle de Québec, shape their own keepsake in a traditional copper workshop, and trace the region’s story through the Musée de la Civilisation and the Plains of Abraham. It’s the perfect blend of education, exploration, and fun—an experience your students will be talking about long after the trip ends.
